title: Mixed Event — Wonder Magical Showtime! — Episode1 Everyone's Thoughts and Feelings

meta.Event Outline: Phoenix Wonderland is faced with a transformation at the hands of Emu's brothers to appeal to the young adult crowd. In order to make sure it stays a place that makes everyone smile, Wonderlands×Showtime prepares a new show. In time, the curtain rises on a show unlike any other!

rows.Line: Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Alright. I understand.
Let's go with that...
se_event_wonders_2021_007

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Keisuke, you're still up?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It appears that Jean Riley, the president of Riley Entertainment, will be arriving here for a final inspection of the park at the beginning of next month as scheduled.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Ah, so the time has finally come.
This deal is as good as done.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I believe so...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But don't look so down.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I also believe that this was our only choice. However...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I came up with other ideas to get more visitors lined up for the rides and attractions that are already here! Like...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: There may've been a way to keep this park afloat while maintaining its current image.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Shosuke.
You also...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It's too late for that, Keisuke.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We did what we had to do based on each situation. There's no point in regretting any of that now.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose you're right...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Oh...?
You two are still up?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Hinata...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Neither of you look very well... Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
No, everything's fine.
I'm going to bed.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Try not to be so hard on yourself, Shosuke.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You too, Keisuke...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh...
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's start our strategy meeting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sir, yes, sir!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sir, yes, sir♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, strategy adviser, front and center!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehehe. My plan is foolproof.
You won't be disappointed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Why are you all acting like this...?
We're just talking today about what we're gonna do about the park, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that was what I heard as well.
I'd like to hear what you all have to say about that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then let's begin with what we already know.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's evident that Phoenix Wonderland has been losing guests at a steady pace for some time now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In order to reverse that, some of the family-oriented attractions were replaced with ones that are more appealing to young people.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thus, some of them were removed to allow the Phoenix Coaster to be built.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even now, children's rides, including the Trampoline Dome and fish coaster, are in danger of being replaced with new rides and attractions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yet these plans haven't actually resulted in a full reversal of the aforementioned attendance figures.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The books may not show it now, but in a few years time, this park may begin falling into the red.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And that's why they decided to partner with Riley Entertainment?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Their intellectual property, particularly their characters, are popular among younger generations and would serve to attract this demographic to the park.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I see...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If this partnership were to actually happen, this park will likely keep transforming to meet the needs of these younger guests.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And if that happens, it'll be a lot harder to make this the park that Emu's grandpa envisioned. “A place that makes everyone smile.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know that Phoenix Wonderland has to keep changing so that it can stay here forever and ever, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If there's some way to make both of those things work, I want to do that...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. So that means...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want the park's operators to realize once more that Phoenix Wonderland is a place where guests of all ages can smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that won't be enough. They'll need to find a different way to attract more guests.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And words won't be enough either. They'll likely want some sort of proof.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So we have to find a way that clearly shows this park will get more people to come here...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, exactly.
Unless we manage to do that first, we won't be able to convince Emu's brothers into rethinking their plans.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Man...!
That sounds so hard...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... They already tried so much and none of it really worked out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it is quite the predicament indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But there's still something we can do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really?!
Like what?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Put on a show of course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. A show that involves every stage as well as every attraction.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, I'd like you all to read through this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! This is amazing!
It's such a super wonderhoy show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it is! This is a fantastic idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The story itself is very straightforward, but the classics are the ones that really tug at your heartstrings! Guests of all ages will surely be able to enjoy this one!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It really does involve every single ride and attraction...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this plan might actually work. I'm sure everyone's gonna love it...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This looks like fun.
I'd like to try it...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep. Me too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm honored that you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But won't you need a much larger cast than normal to make this happen...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's right. There's a limit to how many roles one person or even robots can play.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, so what should we do...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I already have an idea in mind.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll just have to include every troupe from every stage, including all the staff, in Phoenix Wonderland...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This show is all about making everyone remember just what kind of park Phoenix Wonderland is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By including every troupe and all the staff, we'll be able to put on a performance unlike any other.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... You think they'll be willing to help us? I mean, they're all working and doing their own shows...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I understand that convincing them to help us will be quite a challenge. Admittedly, this show is a little out there as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But this show will not be possible without the help of others.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That is why I'd like us to go around to every stage and ask for their assistance.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay...!
We can split up and hear what they have to say!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, when do you plan on putting on this show...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I received a nice tip regarding that. It seems that Emu's brothers and their prospective partner will be inspecting the park at the beginning of next month on the last day of the Show Contest.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like this show to open then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. The last day of the Show Contest...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll be able to turn the tables by using the very idea they came up with against them! Brilliant!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Wait... If that were to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You still want to win the contest, don't you, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hnng...
No, that's okay...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I would be lying if I said that I don't mind not winning despite how much work we put into it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we have something much more important to deal with!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I said it's okay!
We're about to put on a show the likes of which have never been seen before!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
One that no one's ever experienced...
One filled with dreams and wonderment!!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But there is one more thing I'd like to do alongside all that. We'll need to have much more people than normal see this show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The Show Contest itself will already attract quite a few guests, but only to the degree that the operators have predicted.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right... That means we have to do a little more in order to get more people to see this show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But how exactly do we do that...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh...!
What about this, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've been trying to come up with ideas that might get more people to come to the park and wrote it all down in a notebook...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, here it is!
How about this one...? I think it'll be so pretty that everybody will want to come and see it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, this is...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Your dream may just make a miracle happen, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I wanna know too!
What's the plan?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Simply put...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be casting a “smiling spell” over all of Phoenix Wonderland...
